prompt: The activity command fails with a JSON parse error resembling an unexpected end of input when it requests a longer range of history, which looks like a server bug but is self-inflicted. Larger successful responses are being truncated before decoding. Let the real payloads through while keeping a defensive bound on reads. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: API response body read cap limit reader truncation
activity commits large response decode JSON error
unexpected end of JSON input response size
_subject: Raise API response body cap from 1 MiB to 16 MiB
